pattern.description: The cursor lands on the Free Tools sidebar item; the selection highlight jumps to it and the right-hand pricing pane cross-fades from the two-card CRM Suite layout to the single Free Tools card, with the pane content drifting up as it settles.
pattern.why_premium: The click is the cue for the content swap, so the viewer reads cause and effect; the old cards dissolve before the new card arrives (no hard cut), and the swap lands on the narrated word 'free'.

build_hint.remotion: Cursor y via interpolate(frame,[0,6],[0,57],{easing:Easing.out(Easing.quad)}); nav highlight jumps at frame 3; old cards opacity interpolate [3,7]->[1,0]; new pane children opacity/translateY via spring({frame:frame-6-i,fps,config:{damping:200,stiffness:170,mass:1}}) with 1-frame stagger.

notes: facts.json camera.move is tilt_up (pan_y 0.17), but in the filmstrip the sidebar stays fixed while the right pane content moves up after the swap; this looks like a content scroll/reflow in the main pane rather than a true camera tilt. Worth a human look. Event coincides with narration 'free tools'. No SFX candidates.
